description: This file provides a Python interface for GPUDirect Storage (GDS) operations in PyTorch, including buffer registration, deregistration, and a GdsFile class for file-like operations on CUDA storage.

classes.name: GdsFile
classes.description: A wrapper class around cuFile for managing GPU Direct Storage file operations, including registration, deregistration, loading, and saving storage.

methods.name: _dummy_fn
methods.description: Creates a dummy function that raises a RuntimeError indicating the operation is unsupported on the platform.

methods.name: gds_register_buffer
methods.description: Registers a CUDA storage buffer as a cufile buffer using GDS.

methods.name: gds_deregister_buffer
methods.description: Deregisters a previously registered CUDA storage buffer from GDS.
